subject.title: [Feature]: Make Skill Workshop extensible for custom skill creation workflows

question: Should OpenClaw support custom skill-creation authorities before `skill_workshop` selection, and if so should that live as a plugin API hook, a tool-policy convention, or documented ClawHub workflow guidance?
rationale: Current code has proposal primitives, plugin tools, allowlists, and per-tool-call hooks, but choosing a pre-selection authority model changes product behavior and plugin/API boundaries.

options.title: Design a narrow plugin/API authority
options.body: Add a bounded plugin or policy contract that can route skill-creation requests through approved custom workflows before they submit proposal content to Skill Workshop.

options.title: Document current composition only
options.body: Keep Skill Workshop as the prompt-preferred path and document that custom tools may prepare proposal content but cannot replace model tool selection.

options.title: Close as out of core
options.body: Treat custom skill-creation workflows as ClawHub skill/plugin convention only, accepting that OpenClaw core will not enforce a pre-selection authority.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow plugin/API authority
recommendation.body: Add a bounded plugin or policy contract that can route skill-creation requests through approved custom workflows before they submit proposal content to Skill Workshop.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently landed the adjacent bypass fix and explicitly identified this issue as the broader boundary thread.
